compile.actualClasses: official Gecko AAR classes plus official Android SDK37.2 android.jar
compile.scope: javac only, no callback invoked or Android permissions/clipboard access

facts.fact: Clipboard read prompt is SelectionActionDelegate.onShowClipboardPermissionRequest, not PermissionDelegate content callback; screenPoint optional and not gesture proof
ContentPermission has uri/contextId/privateMode/thirdPartyOrigin and notifyShown; UI must call notifyShown once after shown, not as consent
Pinned engine module stores ordinary permission decisions with Services.perms.EXPIRE_NEVER, except storage-access handled separately
Geolocation native path requests ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION after content approval; approximate/precise distinction needs actual integration evidence
StorageController getPermissions(uri,contextId,privateMode) exists; setPermission(original,value) is void dispatch, tracking PROMPT ignored; persistent-storage revocation exception documented
Media permission callback must use original source objects/IDs; OS permission denial can coexist with other source categories, so embedder must suppress inappropriate allow UI

conclusion: finite website lease lifetime is a real unresolved engine-boundary constraint, not solved by native timer or UI metadata
